if: the document is a receipt voucher referred to in clause (d) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 50 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the receipt voucher MUST carry the amount of tax charged by head
note: One mandatory particular of rule 50(h), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: amount of tax charged in respect of taxable goods or services (central tax, State tax, integrated tax, Union territory tax or cess);
